revenueModel.text: The company earns net interest income on loans and leases and noninterest income from service charges and fees on deposit accounts, trust and investment services, and other banking services.
revenueModel.evidence: The increase in noninterest income was primarily due to an increase in other service charges and fees, partially offset by a decrease in trust and investment services income.

changes.text: In 2025, the company reduced its reportable operating segments from three to two, moving Treasury and Other activities into Corporate/Other.
changes.evidence: During the quarter ended December 31, 2025, we realigned our internal organizational and management reporting structure. As a result of this change, we reduced our reportable operating segments from three to two.
